purpose: 给后续 Agent 的小规模公开 benchmark 选型清单。它不是下载任务、生产 ASR 结论、训练许可或自动删剪授权。

candidates.license_as_published: Apache-2.0; official page also says free for academic use
candidates.smallest_next_scope: Use a fixed small test subset outside Git after storage and organizational-use review.
candidates.fit: Low-risk Mandarin ASR sanity check with human transcriptions.
limits: Quiet indoor read speech, not a multi-track conversational podcast.
Cannot evaluate whether fillers, repetitions, pauses or topic detours should be edited.

candidates.smallest_next_scope: Eval archive only; do not fetch Train/Test by default.
measures: diarization metrics only when compatible labels are used
candidates.fit: Real Mandarin meetings with near/far microphones, 2–4 participants and overlap; useful for ASR/VAD/overlap risk screening.
limits: Meeting audio is not a semantic-editing gold set.
Share-alike terms and dataset scale require an explicit organization/license review before use.

candidates.smallest_next_scope: Test split only, after AliMeeting proves value and storage/license review succeeds.
candidates.fit: Real 8-channel Mandarin meetings with transcription and speaker activity; later stress test for crosstalk/overlap tooling.
limits: Larger and more distant from the project's close-mic three-track recording setup.
Not a benchmark for delete intent, naturalness, music or podcast pacing.

questions: Speech: did the voice become damaged, thin, unstable, or less intelligible?
Background: did unwanted noise improve without audible pumping or musical artifacts?
Overall: which version is more comfortable for the whole program?
denoise_evaluation_method.guard: Do not run a cloud DNSMOS service or treat a proxy score as a production decision for private program audio.

exclusions.source_type: finished public podcast or YouTube video without raw tracks and edit map
exclusions.reason: May inform listening taste, but cannot provide valid candidate precision/recall or deletion-intent labels.
May locate possible edits, but cannot become human gold without human verification.

admission_checklist: Record exact official source, license, release/split, download checksum and local path outside Git.
Run only a fixed small split on one machine with fixed engine/model/decoding configuration.
Keep raw dataset and project audio separate; never upload internal media.
Report quality, speed, failures and limitations together.
Pass local EP03 mini-gold and human review before any production-engine replacement.
